title: Figures 2-3: Quantum Dot barrier structure and Programmable Materials
description: Two technical illustrations. "Figure 2. Quantum Dot" shows a block labeled "Barrier" sitting on a larger "Barrier" slab, depicting confinement of electrons in a very small volume. "Figure 3. Programmable Materials" shows a layered device (Conductor, Barrier, Transport Layer, Barrier) with "Confined Electrons" and a voltage source, alongside a fiber cross-section of "Quantum dot particles" surrounding a "Control wire"; the page continues into a section on photonics and metamaterials.
